reproduction: Sign in as Account A and load a personalized profile/Radar so profile and opportunity cache are persisted.
Sign out using the current profile action.
Sign in as Account B on the same device before clearing application storage.
Observe Main hydration before the Account B network refresh completes.
observed_result: AsyncStorage keys for profile and opportunities cache are global (`@obrasignal/v1/profile`, `@obrasignal/v1/opportunities-cache`) and contain no tenant namespace.
Sign-out calls Supabase signOut without purging or rebinding private cached state.
After any signed-in Main mounts, it hydrates cached profile/items immediately before network reconciliation.
Therefore Account B can transiently receive Account A's private personalized profile/opportunity state on first render.
expected_truth: Private mobile cache is tenant-bound, or is completely purged before a different authenticated account can render it.
Cached profile/opportunities must be validated against the authenticated account identity before display.
Account switching never exposes another tenant's personalized data, even transiently or while offline/network-failing.
Shared device settings may remain shared only when explicitly non-private; private workflow/profile/Radar state may not.
required_retest: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: Account A cache cannot be returned/rendered for Account B identity.
PROVEN_AUTOMATED: sign-out/account-change invalidates or isolates private cache before Main hydration.
PROVEN_AUTOMATED: Account B network failure after sign-in does not fall back to Account A private state.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE: A loads data -> signs out -> B signs in offline/slow network -> zero A private content is visible.
hard_boundary: Golden Path owns acceptance/regression only. Cache/session implementation repair remains with Mobile specialist owners.
